{{Quote|Niathal's formally declared the government in exile of the Galactic Alliance on Fondor.|[[Natasi Daala]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation" />}}
The '''Galactic Alliance-in-exile''' was the government set up in [[41 ABY]] by former [[Cha Niathal|Joint Chief of State Number One]] [[Cha Niathal]] after the [[Second Battle of Fondor]], preserving what was left of what was now considered the [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#O|Old Order]] because of its replacement by a [[New Order (Darth Caedus)|New Order]].

==History==
===Second Battle of Fondor===
{{Quote|You can't stop now."<br />"I've accepted Fondor's surrender.|[[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Cha Niathal]]|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation" />}}
During the Second Battle of Fondor, the tensions that had arisen between [[Cha Niathal|JCOS-1]] [[Cha Niathal]] and [[Darth Caedus|JCOS-2]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] finally came to public enmity. Both proceeded to relieve the other of command&mdash;Solo claiming his superiority of a [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] to a [[Supreme Commander]] and Niathal claiming hers as an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] to a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]].

===Aftermath===
Because Solo, now known as [[Darth Caedus]], had retreated to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he claimed the Galactic Capital and what remained of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] as the sole Chief of State. Niathal, left with her fleet and a battle-scarred [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], and believing that she had no chance in a slugging match of fleets above Coruscant, declared an Alliance-in-exile with herself as its head, based at Fondor.

===Reunion===
As the war concluded with the death of the Dark Lord, the Alliance-in-exile re-merged with the main body of the Galactic Alliance, now coming under new leadership in the upcoming election, ending its exile.
